subject: Holiday-aware demo window — split regional walkthrough and recording plan
messages:
From: Hiroshi Sato <hiroshi.sato@zencommerce.co.jp>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Larson <ben.larson@greenthread.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0900
Subject: Intro + request for demo — mindful of holidays

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick connect last week — ZenCommerce is evaluating options to standardize LLM inference for our storefront personalization use cases and we'd like to schedule a product walkthrough and guided demo for our platform and engineering teams.

A couple of scheduling constraints up front so we can avoid churn: our Japan engineering org will be OOO for Golden Week (late Apr / early May) for planning next year, and some senior folks (including our CTO Priya) will be OOO around Diwali (early Nov window) for family leave. We want to avoid scheduling the main technical deep-dive during those windows.

High-level ask: 60–90 minute walkthrough + 30 minute Q&A. We'd prefer a split approach (short APAC-focused session + a separate EMEA/US session) if that's not too heavy.

Proposed weeks: week of Nov 15 or Nov 22. Please send a couple of slot options with timezone conversions (JST/CET/PST) and we'll confirm.

Attendees likely: myself (platform lead), Priya Iyer (CTO) - may be OOO depending on the date, Ben Larson (product).

Best,
Hiroshi
Hiroshi Sato
Head of Platform, ZenCommerce
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Hiroshi Sato <hiroshi.sato@zencommerce.co.jp>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 18:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + request for demo — mindful of holidays

Hi Hiroshi — great to hear from you and thanks for the context. Splitting the demo into two shorter regional sessions is exactly the approach we recommend when there are timezone/OOO constraints — keeps the session tight for core attendees and lets us tailor examples for each region's infra and compliance needs.

Proposed slots (all listed in UTC / JST / PST):
- Option A: Nov 17, 08:00 UTC / Nov 17, 17:00 JST / Nov 17, 00:00 PST (APAC-friendly)
- Option B: Nov 18, 02:00 UTC / Nov 18, 11:00 JST / Nov 17, 18:00 PST (late APAC / afternoon US overlap)
- Option C: Nov 19, 15:00 UTC / Nov 19, 00:00 JST / Nov 19, 07:00 PST (EMEA/US primary)

If Priya is likely to be out during the Nov 16–18 window, we can: 1) record the APAC session for her and schedule a 30-minute follow-up Q&A; or 2) push the EMEA/US session a day later so Priya can join live. Either works.

I've attached an availability grid (availability-grid.csv) and a short regional demo outline (regional-demo-outline.pdf) so you can see who on our side would present for each segment and the suggested agenda.

Please confirm which option you prefer and who must be on the live call. Also OK to create a Calendly for self-scheduling — here's a link if you'd like to pick directly: https://calendly.com/rishi-redwood/demo-zencommerce

Thanks — I'll loop in Monica from CS to handle invites/logistics once you confirm.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Ben can cover product questions for Europe; I'll confirm exact attendee list by Monday.

We'll take Option B for the APAC session and would like the EMEA/US session to be on Nov 19 or later so Priya can attend if needed. Could you and Monica propose the EMEA/US slot for Nov 19?

APAC session (live): Nov 18, 02:00 UTC / Nov 18, 11:00 JST — 60 minutes demo + 30 minutes Q&A (we will record). Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890
EMEA/US session (live): Nov 19, 15:00 UTC — 75 minutes tailored demo + 30 minute Q&A (Priya invited).

Thanks — we'll keep the demos concise and provide a short appendix on Golden Week / holiday OOO considerations for recurring runbooks.

— Rishi
